qualityRule: No method may invent a position, clearance, opening, lining or support requirement not stated by the controlling manufacturer document.

notes: Opening, setting-out, construction, duct connection, support and source fields are stored by tested method.
No method may inherit a rule from another BSB product family unless the controlling BSB document explicitly states it.
FSD-TD-S and FSD-TD-C share the FSD-TD tested installation-method records but retain separate spigot and casing geometry.
FSD-TD-C is enabled only for the circular diameters explicitly listed in BSB FSD-TD Series V12607.
FD-C-AF is a separate FD Series curtain-blade product code: Type C circular spigot plus Angle Frame. BSB FD Series V12607 permits Ø100–1000 in millimetre increments, including Ø355 and Ø560.
FD-C-AF casing and Angle Frame dimensions remain separate from the nominal duct and from the aperture gap.
FSD-TD-O remains verification-required because the supplied series document does not publish a complete orderable flat-oval size/configuration table for validating arbitrary inputs.
SmokeShield width includes its 28 mm PTC shroud and excludes the peripheral flange.
Builder setting-out is populated from the selected tested opening geometry; nominal duct bottom is the default datum.
Supports, fixing flaps, sealing, separation, pairing and access notes remain method-specific.
FNC1U remains locked for Project Packs until its controlling installation manual is supplied.
WKS25 Type A discrepancy is retained in the audit log; the full installation booklet controls the live +75 mm method.
Exact, minimum/maximum and per-edge opening rules use schema v2.0.
AFS methods permit non-central positioning: builder AFFL requires an explicit bottom clearance/position selection within the manufacturer limits.
No midpoint is silently presented as a manufacturer requirement.
Pack enablement remains method-specific until casing/frame-to-nominal datum geometry is fully audited.
